title: Senior Principal Engineer
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the engineering hub of Deutsche Telekom, Europe’s #1 telecom brand. We build the digital products that millions of customers across Europe use every day. AI-first by design, we don't just adopt new technology, we build with it.

You will be part of Deutsche Telekom:

#1 most valuable telecom brand in the world, and #11 across all brands (Brand Finance Global 500, 2026)

* Top 100 in the Fortune Global 500 (#72 in 2025)
* EUR 119 billion Group revenue in 2025
* 273 million+ mobile customers in 50+ countries

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

With the right team, anything is possible.

Every product sold, every transaction completed, every customer journey that just works, this team is behind it. If you're energised by scale, obsessed with the customer experience, and want to build commerce infrastructure that actually moves the needle for millions of people, you'll thrive here. We ship in days, own what we build, and never stop trying to make it better.

**YOU ASK WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? WE SAY,**

* AI tools, on us — Every engineer ships with AI. Coding agents, token budgets and hackfests to build what's next.
* Grow faster — Free Coursera & Udemy access, certifications and internal mobility across teams.
* Time to recharge — Uncapped leaves, birthday leave, flexible hours, and sabbatical options.
* Family first — 9 months maternity on full pay, 15 days paternity, crèche support, infertility treatment and adoption leave.
* Health & wellness — Medical cover up to ₹15L for you and your family, unlimited free doctor consults, 24/7 counselling and free Cult.fit membership.
* Money & everyday — Flexi benefits for car, fuel and books. Free meals and snacks on campus. Monthly phone and broadband allowance, plus relocation support when you need it.

**What exactly is the objective of this role?**

We are looking for a highly accomplished
**Senior Principal Engineer – iOS**
to lead the architecture, design, and development of next-generation mobile experiences for millions of users. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who has successfully built and scaled consumer-facing products from
**0 to 1**
, navigated complex engineering challenges, and driven technical excellence in high-growth environments.

You will play a critical role in defining the mobile technology vision, influencing product strategy, mentoring senior engineers, and delivering highly scalable, reliable, and performant iOS applications.

**What will be my Key Responsibilities?**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture and development of large-scale iOS applications.
* Drive the technical vision and roadmap for iOS platforms, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Build products from concept to launch, including defining architecture, development practices, and engineering standards.
* Solve complex technical challenges related to scale, performance, reliability, security, and user experience.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, Data, and Business teams to deliver impactful customer experiences.
* Establish best practices around software design, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and release management.
* Lead technical reviews, architectural discussions, and critical decision-making processes.
* Mentor senior engineers and help build a strong engineering culture focused on innovation and execution excellence.
* Drive adoption of modern iOS technologies and continuously improve engineering productivity.
* Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders through technical leadership and strategic thinking.

**Ideal candidate profile?**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 11–15 years of software engineering experience, with at least 8+ years focused on iOS application development.
* Proven experience building and launching products from
  **0 to 1**
  in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong background in consumer internet (
  **B2C**
  ) products serving large user bases.
* Deep expertise in
  **Swift**
  , iOS SDK, UIKit, and modern iOS development frameworks.
* Strong understanding of software architecture patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, Modular Architecture, and Dependency Injection.
* Experience designing systems that handle scale, high availability, and performance optimization.
* Strong knowledge of networking, concurrency, memory management, offline-first architectures, and application security.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and release management.
* Proven ability to influence engineering direction across teams and organizations.
* Experience scaling mobile products to millions of users.
* Exposure to SwiftUI and modern Apple ecosystem technologies.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, personalization, analytics, and growth-focused product development.
* Track record of driving major platform migrations or architectural transformations.
* Experience working in high-growth startups or rapidly scaling technology companies.
* Contributions to open-source projects, engineering blogs, patents, or technical conferences are a plus.

**Why This Role?**

* Build digital products from scratch on modern, cloud-native infrastructure.
* A real mandate to run lean and AI-first — not lip service, but how we actually operate.
* Influence at both ends — hands-on enough to matter in the detail, senior enough to shape strategy.
* A fast, agile culture where releases ship quickly and your judgment drives the roadmap.

**WITH THE RIGHT TEAM, ANYTHING IS POSSIBLE.**

If you're looking for an environment that's fun and friendly but incredibly fast-paced; a place where we measure the time between releases in days; a place where our focus begins and ends at the consumer, we'd love to have you!

**JOIN US!**

title: Manager, AI Solutions Engineer, People & Culture
description:
**Shape What's Next With BCD**
**Manager, AI Solutions Engineer, People & Culture (Remote)**
Full time, Delhi, India
  
  
The Lead AI Solutions Engineer, People Technology is a senior, hands-on individual contributor responsible for designing and building secure, scalable AI-powered products and intelligent employee experiences. The role combines AI engineering, full-stack development, enterprise architecture, and product thinking to take solutions from concept and prototype through MVP to production.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Architect and build enterprise AI and GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, AI agents, multimodal AI, and agentic orchestration
* Design secure agentic workflows capable of reasoning, retrieving information, invoking tools, and executing multi-step processes
* Build RAG solutions incorporating embeddings, vector/hybrid search, reranking, and grounded responses
* Personally build complete AI products, not just prototypes or architecture
* Develop modern experiences using React/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native
* Build backend services using Python, Node.js, FastAPI/Flask, Express.js and REST APIs
* Connect AI solutions with SAP SuccessFactors and the wider People Technology ecosystem
* Establish reusable AI architecture and engineering patterns
* Build cloud-native solutions across Azure and/or AWS
* Embed security, privacy and Responsible AI principles into solution design

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
* Extensive experience in software engineering, application development, or enterprise technology
* Strong recent hands-on experience building AI/GenAI solutions
* Strong full-stack engineering foundation
* Proven ability to take solutions from idea/POC through MVP into production
* Experience with cloud-native architecture and enterprise integrations
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical IC and influence without formal authority
* Experience with HR/People Technology solutions and enterprise HCM platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors
* Knowledge of enterprise security, data privacy, Responsible AI, and AI governance
* Exposure to HR/People Technology, employee-facing technology or enterprise HR processes strongly preferred

**Why you’ll love working here**
Join a global industry leader where curiosity drives innovation, growth is continuous, and every voice matters. At BCD, you'll have the freedom to make an impact, the support to develop your potential, and the opportunity to help shape the future of travel.
  
  
**Meet BCD**
BCD Travel creates connections that move people and ideas forward. Through open technology and trusted human expertise, we help companies and people navigate change, simplify complexity and make confident decisions about how and when they travel. Our intuitive digital experiences for every stakeholder power journeys that fuel success and drive progress. With 15,000+ dedicated team members serving clients in 170+ countries, BCD is shaping a more sustainable future for business travel. Industry-leading meetings and events management and a global consultancy complete our suite of solutions and services. In 2025, BCD achieved $24.4 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.
  
  
Get to know us by exploring our career site and checking out our social media:
  
  

* Career site BCD
* https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/
* https://www.instagram.com/bcdtravel/
* https://www.bcdtravel.com/blog/

**What’s In It For You**

* Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
* Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
* Work at the forefront of travel technology and help shape the future of business travel
* Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
* A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
* Travel industry professional perks and discounts
* An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated
* Work From Anywhere opportunity for 60 days per year

**Ready to shape what’s next? Apply now!**
We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Founding Member, Senior Innovation Engineer (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description: Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work? J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets. The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations. Job DescriptionThe Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.Key ResponsibilitiesRapid Prototyping & Solution DevelopmentBuild functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users. Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants. Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability. Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale. Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable. Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language. AI, Agents & Automation EngineeringDesign and build AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure services, and other approved technologies. Develop and evaluate AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation patterns, prompt and orchestration logic, knowledge grounding, tool use, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls. Integrate solutions with enterprise data, content, APIs, applications, and identity services while following approved access and security patterns. Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case. Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions. Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate. Cloud, Architecture & Technical FeasibilityDesign and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure. Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost. Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop. Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions. Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk. Engineering Foundations & Delivery PracticesPartner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry. Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist. Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration. Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk. Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability. Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks. Collaboration, Reuse & ScaleWork closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff. Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage. Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions. Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model. Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions. · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty. QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions. Demonstrated hands-on experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or closely comparable enterprise platforms. Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications. Hands-on cloud development experience in Microsoft Azure is required; experience across multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, is strongly preferred. Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, event-driven or serverless patterns, identity and access management, data stores, enterprise integrations, monitoring, and secure application design. Experience with AI application patterns such as agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model and prompt orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool use, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Experience establishing or improving development foundations, including source control, branching, automated testing, environments, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices. title: Senior Android Developer
description:
We are looking for an Android Engineer to build custom Android applications. Candidates should be able to develop an Android application from initial conception through submittal to the Android marketplace. The ideal candidate will not just be an outstanding engineer but will bring a mindset of creativity, innovation, and balance bleeding edge technology development with a relentless pursuit of timely product engineering delivery.

**Areas of Responsibility:**

* Be involved in all aspects of development playing a critical role in the design, planning, development, and deployment and help develop best practices for future development.
* Fast prototyping of proof-of concept features/application based on the brief.
* Develop and maintain new features on Mobile Application development & Java stack.
* Own the delivery of an entire piece of a system or application
* Responsibility to develop unit test cases for his/her project module.
* Use technical knowledge and creative thinking to provide the most innovative solutions
* Optimizing performance for the apps and keep up to date on the latest industry trends in mobile technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years of experience in software development with a B.E. / B.Tech. / M.E. / M.Tech. / M.S. in Computer Science, Electronics, or related field.
* Strong understanding of mobile application development in Android.
* Experience with a start-up would be an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on working on Java and Kotlin in a production-level environment
* Good understanding of various design patterns like MVVM/ MVP/ MVI / MVC and Android Architecture Components and experience in writing unit and UI test cases
* Solid understanding of the full Android application development life cycle from design to delivery and experience with third-party libraries and APIs eg. RxJava, Retrofit, Dagger, Glide.
* Deep Knowledge of Android core features Activities, Services, BroadCast Receivers, Intents, Handlers and Background application processing
* Experience of working with Coroutines is a plus
* Experience working with Android Background Application Processing, Battery Optimization, Memory Optimization, Multi-Threading, Location API, Push Notifications, Remote Config,
* Experience working in larger, multi-modular code bases and well versed with Git source control
* Working knowledge of the general mobile landscape, architectures, trends, and emerging technologies

title: Web Development Intern
description:
**Web Developer Intern**

We're hiring: Web Developer Intern at Infrasity

📍 Location: Janakpuri, New Delhi (Hybrid)

⏳ Duration: 2 months

🗓️ Work Week: 5 days a week

🎓 Experience: 0-1 year

Apply only if you can come to our Janakpuri, New Delhi office.

About Infrasity

Infrasity is a developer marketing company helping AI and B2B SaaS startups reach developers through technical content, social media, product documentation, videos, podcasts, and developer-focused GTM.

We work with startups building AI infrastructure, developer tools, cloud-native platforms, DevOps, security, platform engineering, and enterprise software.

If you're excited about AI, love building things, and want to work directly with founders building global brands, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Web Developer Intern with 0-1 year of experience. If you have a knack for learning new tech stacks and want hands-on experience building client-facing web pages and GitHub projects, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

- Write clean, quality code to build products that scale

- Build and ship client web pages and applications using JavaScript, React, and Next.js

- Create GitHub projects and sample repos based on client requirements

- Develop, implement, and test APIs and SDKs

- Detect, debug, and resolve issues across the stack

- Deploy and manage projects on Vercel, with an eye on performance and reliability

- Build and use Claude Skills, MCP servers, and agentic coding workflows, with a working understanding of how these systems orchestrate tools, context, and outputs behind the scenes

- Use Git for version control and collaborative development

- Contribute to internal tools and ship features alongside the team

- Write clear technical documentation (READMEs, setup guides) for everything you build

- Work with the team to troubleshoot real-world customer and partner issues

- Share your input on software architecture and development decisions

What We're Looking For

- Proficiency or strong foundational knowledge of JavaScript, React, and Next.js

- Experience working with APIs, and comfort with relational or non-relational databases

- Comfort with Git and GitHub workflows (branches, PRs, issues)

- Familiarity with deployment tools like Vercel and GitHub Actions

- Sharp debugging skills: you trace an issue to its root cause instead of just patching symptoms

- Practical exposure to Claude Skills, MCP tools, or agentic AI workflows, and an understanding of why they behave the way they do, not just how to prompt them

- Ability to write clear and effective technical documentation

- A high-ownership mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment

Preferred Skills

- Experience deploying on Vercel or similar platforms

- Familiarity with agentic AI tools (Claude Code, MCP servers, Cursor, or similar), with genuine curiosity about how orchestration, tool-calling, and context management work

Bonus Points

- You've built and shipped your own side projects, not just tutorials or bootcamp work

- You've experimented with agentic coding tools beyond basic prompting

- You enjoy following the latest trends in AI, dev tools, and engineering workflows

Why Join Infrasity?

- Build products for a fast-growing global developer marketing company

- Get hands-on exposure to AI and developer-first startups

- Use the latest AI and agentic tools in your daily workflow

- High ownership, fast learning, and real impact from day one

How to Apply

Send us:

- Your resume

- Links to projects or repos you're proud of

- Any code samples or technical work you'd like to highlight

📩 sid@infrasity.com

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
  
  
UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with very large distributed systems
* Knowledge of design process
* Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Amendss supports people across different relationship phases, from forming and maintaining bonds to working through challenges and personal growth. The team is dedicated to helping users build relationships that feel balanced, fulfilling, and resilient as their lives and circumstances evolve. Applicants can expect to work in a mission-driven environment focused on improving everyday relationship experiences.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram for a B2C Mobile App Marketing Consultant. The consultant will design and execute mobile-first marketing strategies to drive user acquisition, activation, and retention for Amendss’s consumer app across key channels. Daily tasks include planning and managing performance marketing campaigns, coordinating app store optimization, tracking user behavior and funnel metrics, and running experiments to improve conversion rates. The role involves collaborating with product, design, and content teams to develop in-app campaigns, push notifications, and personalized journeys that align with user needs and brand positioning. The consultant will analyze data and insights to refine targeting, optimize spend, and report on campaign effectiveness, while contributing to overall growth strategy in the B2C space.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in B2C mobile app growth, including user acquisition, activation, and retention for consumer-facing apps.
* Proficiency in performance marketing across channels such as paid social, search, display, and app install campaigns.
* Hands-on experience with app analytics tools, user funnels, cohort analysis, and data-driven optimization.
* Familiarity with app store optimization (ASO), including keywords, metadata, creative testing, and reviews management.
* Ability to design and run experiments (A/B tests), measure results, and iterate on marketing and product touchpoints.
* Strong collaboration skills to work with product, design, content, and counselling teams on integrated campaigns.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to craft clear, empathetic messaging for end users.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Psychology, or a related field; advanced certifications in digital marketing or growth marketing are an advantage.
* Prior experience in healthtech, mental health, wellness, or relationship-focused products is beneficial.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage environment, with a user-centric mindset and sensitivity to emotional well-being topics.

title: Technology consultant/ Fractional CTO
description:
**We're Hiring: Technology Consultant / Fractional CTO**

**Engineering Hiring | Technology Architecture | Strategic Advisory**

📍 
**Location:**
 Gurgaon, Haryana / Remote

💼 
**Engagement:**
 Paid Consulting / Contract / Fractional Advisory

🎯 
**Experience:**
 8+ years preferred (strong technical expertise takes priority over years of experience)

🚀 
**Opportunity:**
 Initial project-based engagement with potential for a long-term advisory partnership

**About Aumraa**

At 
**Aumraa**
, we're on a mission to build India's next-generation 
**Devotional Super App**
 — a unified faith-tech ecosystem that brings together temples, pujas, spiritual guidance, devotional content, sacred commerce and community, with a vision to become a trusted digital companion for millions of devotees.

As an early-stage startup, we're establishing our in-house technology team and laying the foundation for a scalable digital platform spanning web, mobile applications, commerce, service bookings and integrations.

**About the Opportunity**

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on 
**Technology Consultant / Fractional CTO / Engineering Leader**
 to work closely with our founder and help us make informed technical decisions as we build Aumraa.

**Our immediate priority is to hire Full-Stack Developers**
, and we need an experienced technology professional who can independently assess candidates, lead technical evaluations and help us build a capable engineering team.

Beyond recruitment, we envision this evolving into a long-term technology advisory relationship, supporting our platform architecture, mobile application development, engineering standards and broader technology initiatives.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys working with early-stage startups, combining hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking and helping founders translate ambitious product visions into reliable, scalable technology. Engagement Structure

**This is not a conventional full-time CTO position OR Co-founder position.**
We are initially seeking an independent technology consultant for a defined, paid technical hiring engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Hiring & Candidate Evaluation — Immediate Priority**

* Review and refine technical job descriptions, skill requirements and evaluation criteria for Senior and Junior Full-Stack Developer positions.
* Design and conduct structured technical interviews covering Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, databases and API development.
* Evaluate candidates on coding proficiency, debugging, problem-solving, system design, security fundamentals and real-world development experience.
* Develop practical technical assessments appropriate to each experience level.
* Assess candidates' ability to independently develop, maintain and deploy production-ready applications.
* Provide structured candidate scorecards, comparative assessments and clear hiring recommendations.
* Advise on engineering team structure, role ownership and technical competency expectations.

**2. Technology Architecture & Strategic Advisory — Longer-Term Scope**

* Review Aumraa's existing technology stack and recommend improvements where necessary.
* Advise on backend architecture, frontend architecture, database design, API standards and third-party integrations.
* Evaluate and recommend the appropriate mobile application framework, including React Native versus Flutter.
* Guide architectural decisions involving scalability, performance, security, maintainability and cost efficiency.
* Recommend infrastructure, cloud deployment, CI/CD, monitoring and development practices suited to an early-stage technology company.
* Help establish a practical technical roadmap aligned with Aumraa's product development priorities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical debt and potential implementation bottlenecks before they become costly.

**3. Engineering Guidance & Development Oversight — Ongoing Advisory Scope**

* Provide periodic technical guidance and mentorship to Aumraa's in-house engineering team.
* Review critical code, architecture decisions and implementation approaches.
* Help establish coding standards, code review practices, testing expectations and documentation guidelines.
* Advise on technical task breakdown, development estimates and engineering milestones.
* Review development progress and help resolve complex technical challenges.
* Support technical evaluations of external vendors, integrations and technology partners when required.
* Act as a trusted technology advisor to the founder on important engineering decisions.

**Technical Expertise Required**

* **Strong hands-on expertise in:**
* **Backend:**

   Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, RESTful APIs, authentication and authorisation.
* **Frontend:**

   React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript and modern frontend architecture.
* **Databases:**

   Relational database design, SQL, data modelling and performance optimisation.
* **Architecture:**

   System design, modular architecture, API integration, scalability and secure application development.
* **Engineering Practices:**

   Git, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and production deployment.
* **Security:**

   Application security, secure coding principles, access controls and data protection.

**Additional experience that would be valuable:**

* React Native and/or Flutter mobile application development.
* AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.
* Shopify, e-commerce integrations and third-party commerce platforms.
* Payment gateways, booking systems, notifications and service-oriented platform integrations.
* Experience designing or scaling consumer-facing web and mobile products.

*Expertise in our core Java/Spring Boot and React stack is essential. Direct experience with every additional technology is not mandatory.*

**Who We're Looking For**

* An experienced professional who:
* Has preferably 
  **8+ years of software engineering experience**

  , including substantial hands-on development and architecture responsibilities.
* Has worked as a CTO, Fractional CTO, Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, Solution Architect, Principal Engineer or Senior Full-Stack Engineer.
* Has personally built, shipped or scaled production-grade digital products.
* Can evaluate both junior and senior engineering candidates with confidence.
* Has experience mentoring developers and establishing practical engineering standards.
* Understands the challenges, resource constraints and decision-making needs of an early-stage startup.
* Can communicate complex technical decisions clearly to a non-technical founder.
* Takes a pragmatic, business-oriented approach rather than recommending unnecessarily complex technology solutions.
* Is comfortable working independently and providing objective technical recommendations.
* Experience advising startups or building engineering teams from the ground up will be a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

**During the initial engagement:**

* Clear technical evaluation criteria for the two Full-Stack Developer positions.
* Well-structured interviews and practical assessments.
* Objective, documented candidate evaluations.
* Confident hiring recommendations supported by technical evidence.
* Clear expectations for each developer's responsibilities and capabilities.

**As the relationship develops:**

* A well-defined, scalable technology architecture.
* Informed decisions about our mobile framework and supporting infrastructure.
* Improved engineering quality and technical accountability.
* A capable in-house development team supported by consistent technical guidance.

Based on mutual fit, availability and business requirements, the engagement may subsequently expand into a longer-term, fractional technology advisory relationship.

We welcome applications from independent consultants, fractional CTOs and experienced engineering leaders offering consulting services.

**Location:**
 Remote engagement is welcome. Gurgaon-based professionals are also encouraged to apply.

**Compensation:**
 Competitive consulting fees, based on relevant experience and the agreed scope of work.

**How to Apply**

If you have strong engineering expertise, enjoy solving real-world technology challenges and would like to help an ambitious startup build its engineering foundation, we'd love to connect.

📩 
**Apply here or email**

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment
description:
**Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment**

**About Urban Company**

Urban Company is Asia's largest tech-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high-quality, and reliable experience every single time.

**About the Fulfilment Team**

The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:

- Planning & Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.

- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.

- Allocation & Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.

These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.

**Job Description: SDE-2**

We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE-2) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.

**Responsibilities**

- Design and build scalable, high-performance, fault-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.

- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.

- Own features end-to-end — from ideation and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration across a modern tech stack.

- Raise the bar on the team's engineering practices: code quality, system architecture, observability, and operational excellence.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into robust technical solutions.

**What Are We Looking For?**

- Experience: 2–3 years of experience building large-scale backend applications or Products.

-Technical Strength: Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Networks, and Database fundamentals, with a good understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, caching, and scalable architectures.

- Backend Skills: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Java, Go, or Python). Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and messaging systems like Kafka is a plus; exposure to cloud platforms and production observability is desirable.

- AI Fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging AI in day-to-day engineering — using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to ship faster, and/or building with LLMs, ML models, or intelligent automation in production systems. Curiosity to apply.

- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.

- Mindset: Bias for action, end-to-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.

- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

**Why Join Us?**

- Work on marketplace-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.

- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.

- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first-principles thinking.

title: IT Engineer,Software,Senior
description:
****Overview****
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Platform Optimization & Org Health**

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

****Qualifications****
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.

**Good to have AI Exposure**

* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and API-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–9 years of hands-on Salesforce platform development — cloud-agnostic, problem-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.

title: Senior Client Engineer
description:
**Senior Client Engineer (Gurugram-Hybrid)**
**About Finova**
Finova is the UK's leading lending and savings technology provider, supporting one in every five mortgages nationwide. Our agile, cloud-native solutions enable over 60 banks, building societies, specialist lenders, equity release providers and a network of 2,400+ brokers to stay ahead in a competitive market.
  
  
Built on open architecture and backed by deep industry expertise, our platform is designed to scale. Each year, we process over £50 billion in loans, manage nearly £50 billion in savings, and support the digital servicing of more than 650,000 UK borrower accounts.
  
  
Be part of a team that’s driving innovation, enabling growth and shaping the future of UK lending.
  
  
**For Lenders**
Finova offers a flexible, modular technology suite designed to help lenders move faster, scale efficiently and deliver standout digital experiences.
  
  
Financial Institutions use Finova to launch products faster, process applications up to 50% more efficiently and reduce operational costs — all while staying fully compliant in a fast-moving market.
  
  
**About the Role:**
As a Senior Engineer at Finova, you will play a key role in developing, enhancing, and maintaining our core UK lending and digital banking platforms. You will design and write clean, scalable code using C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL, and RESTful APIs, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability across our software solutions. Working in an Agile environment, you will participate in code reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful software features.
  
  
**About you:**

* Leading technical delivery on user stories: estimating effort, build complex configurations and integrations.
* Participate in refinement sessions to ensure stories meet acceptance criteria and are sprint ready.
* Mentoring and coaching Developer-level colleagues, reviewing pull requests to uphold coding standards.
* Liaising with clients or third-party engineers on complex technical issues (interfaces, integrations).
* Identifying and mitigating technical risks within sprints, escalating dependencies or blockers as needed.
* Providing release support and contributing to production-issue diagnosis and resolution.

**What will you be doing?**
In terms of your experience, your attitude is everything, but we'd particularly love to see your:
  
  

* Experienced or proficiency in C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL and RESTful APIs. Confidence in code reviews, ensuring quality and adherence to best practice.
* Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders and escalate issues appropriately.
* Experience of Agile delivery at scale, from planning through to warranty support.
* Demonstrable track record of guiding junior team members through coaching or formal training.
* Commitment to continuous learning, sharing insights via presentations or internal communities.

**What we Offer:**

* Hybrid working: We operate on a flexible hybrid model that gives you the choice and freedom to balance working from the office and working remotely.
* Private medical insurance: Comprehensive health floater cover covering your spouse and children, ensuring complete medical protection for your family.

* Flexible Holiday Package: Enjoy 30 days paid holiday (plus 10 public holidays) with the option to encash or carry forward unused leaves into the next year.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re passionate about this role but don’t meet all the criteria, please reach out, we’d love to discuss how your skills and experiences align with our needs.

* Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, Agile teams.

title: Co-Founder & CTO
description:
**I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me.**

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business.

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising.

**What you'll be building:**

* Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development.
* Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure.
* Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future.
* Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users.
* Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow.
* Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions.
* Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features.

**Who I'm looking for:**

* 7–12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development.
* Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers.
* Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything.
* A problem solver who understands business as much as technology.
* Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow.
* Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.

**One thing you should know.**

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort.

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves.

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5–10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there.

**This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement.**
We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently.

I don't expect you to know everything.

title: Zoho CRM & Integration Specialist
description:
🚨IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ THE COMPLETE JOB REQUIREMENTS BEFORE APPLYING

THIS IS A TECHNICAL, HANDS-ON CRM IMPLEMENTATION & INTEGRATION ROLE. THE REQUIREMENTS LISTED BELOW ARE MANDATORY.

CANDIDATES MUST HAVE PRACTICAL EXPERIENCE IN CRM IMPLEMENTATION, API INTEGRATIONS, DIALER/TELEPHONY INTEGRATION, AUTOMATION, AND TROUBLESHOOTING.

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY RANDOMLY. APPLY ONLY IF YOU HAVE PERSONALLY WORKED ON THE RELEVANT TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATIONS AND CAN EXPLAIN YOUR CONTRIBUTION IN DETAIL.

PLEASE NOTE: A PRACTICAL TECHNICAL ASSIGNMENT WILL BE MANDATORY AFTER THE FIRST SCREENING ROUND.

Position: Zoho CRM & Integration Specialist

Experience: Relevant hands-on experience in CRM implementation and integrations

Location: Janakpuri, New Delhi

Employment Type: Full-time | On-site

Salary: 6 LPA - 9.5 LPA

Experience: 4-6 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically proficient CRM professional who can independently implement, integrate, automate, and troubleshoot business systems. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience connecting CRM platforms with lead-generation sources, WhatsApp, dialers, telephony systems, and other business applications.

This is not a basic CRM data-entry, CRM administration, or campaign-execution role. We need someone who understands integrations at a technical level and can diagnose and resolve real-world issues.

1. CRM Implementation & Integration — Mandatory

* Experience handling Zoho CRM implementation, from requirement gathering and configuration to testing and go-live.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho CRM APIs and third-party integrations.
* Integration of website forms with CRM for automated lead capture.
* Integration with WhatsApp platforms, Meta Lead Ads, and other lead-generation channels.
* Experience integrating TagMango with a CRM or another business platform.
* Implementation of duplicate lead prevention across multiple lead sources.
* Building customer-matching logic using mobile numbers, email addresses, or unique customer IDs.
* Troubleshooting failed APIs and resolving integration issues.

2. Dialer & Telephony Integration — Mandatory

* Hands-on experience integrating CRM with dialers or telephony platforms.
* Exposure to Ozonetel, Exotel, Ameyo, or equivalent platforms.
* Configuration of auto-dialer campaigns.
* Automated capture of call start time, end time, duration, agent details, call status, and recording URLs.
* Mapping call logs and recordings to the correct lead or customer.
* Experience investigating SIP disconnections during auto-dialling, independently or in coordination with a telephony provider.

3. Automation, Dashboards & Coding — Mandatory

* Building automated follow-up and reactivation journeys for inactive leads or existing customers.
* Creating CRM dashboards for leads, sales activity, conversions, and agent performance.
* Writing and debugging scripts or custom functions for CRM automation.
* Practical experience with Deluge, JavaScript, Python, Google Apps Script, or a comparable programming language.

Technical Skills

* CRM: Zoho CRM
* APIs & Integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, third-party integrations
* Telephony: Ozonetel, Exotel, Ameyo, or similar platforms
* Automation & Coding: Deluge, JavaScript, Python, Google Apps Script, or equivalent

Selection Process

1. Initial resume screening.
2. Technical screening questionnaire covering the mandatory requirements.
3. Mandatory practical technical assignment after the first screening round.
4. Technical discussion and final evaluation.

Candidates must be able to explain actual implementations, the challenges encountered, and how they resolved them. Merely knowing the names of tools or having theoretical knowledge will not be sufficient.

* FINAL REQUEST: PLEASE READ ALL THE REQUIREMENTS CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING. APPLY ONLY IF YOUR HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE MATCHES THE TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS OF THIS ROLE.

You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!Required Skills['Flutter', 'FlutterFlow']Additional InformationSource recruiter: Poppy Hosford Source recruiter designation: Chief of Staff Company tagline: Providing kangaroo care Employee count: 10 Company founded: 2023 Benefits: Competitive nonprofit compensation, Health insurance, Flexibility in how you work, Premium health insurance, Growth opportunity, Continuous improvement and collaboration Company tech stack: BigQuery, Flutter, Python, SQL, Machine Learning Website: https://www.ansh.health/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ansh-health/about/ Instahyre score: NA Strong match: NA Accept outstation: true Company tagline: Providing kangaroo care Logo: https://media.instahyre.com/images/profile/base/employer/56044/e3e6b4d1be/ansh_health_logo.webp

We're looking for
