title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
description:
**About Us**
We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.
  
  
Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.
  
  
You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.
  
  
Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.
  
  
You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.
  
  
Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
* Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
* Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
* Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
* Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
* Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
* Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
* Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
* Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
* Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
* Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

* Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
* Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
* Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
* Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
* Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
* The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
* Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
* Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
* A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
* The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
* A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
* Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
* Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
* Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
* Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
* Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
* Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
* Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
* Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
* Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

**What We Offer**

* A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
* Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
* The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
* The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

**How To Apply**
Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:
  
  

* Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
* Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
* Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
* AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
* Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

support customers across utilities, smart infrastructure, and industrial domains. We foster a collaborative environment

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

mechanisms.

title: Head of Injection Moulding (Mobile Industry)
description:
HEAD OF INJECTION MOULDING

**Faridabad, Delhi NCR | On-site | 12–18 years | Reports to the founders**
**Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma — Plastics, Polymer, Mechanical or Production Engineering**
**Mobile handset industry moulding experience is mandatory — please read below before applying**

Moulding is where our product starts, and where our cost is set. A part moulded badly becomes a part printed badly, assembled badly and rejected at pack — by which point we've paid for all of it.

You'd own moulding as a function: the floor, the process, the people, the capacity and the capital. That includes
**overmoulding**
— rigid shell with soft-touch elastomer — which is a meaningful part of what we produce and a materially harder process than single-shot.

**We are only considering candidates from the mobile handset industry**

We want to be direct about this so nobody wastes their time.

We make small, cosmetically critical parts — sub-millimetre wall sections, visible surfaces with no tolerance for sink or flow marks, tight fit against a device, and cosmetic standards closer to consumer electronics than to general plastics. A part that would pass in most moulding shops gets rejected here.

The discipline that produces that output is learned in the handset supply chain, and it doesn't transfer quickly from elsewhere. Excellent moulding experience in automotive, appliance, packaging, housewares or general engineering plastics is genuinely excellent experience — it just isn't what this role needs, and we'd be setting you up to struggle.

**So:**
you should have spent meaningful time moulding handset housings, covers or cosmetic enclosures — at
**Oppo, Vivo, Xiaomi, Realme, Transsion, Foxconn, Dixon, Lava**
or in their tier-one supplier base. Adjacent consumer electronics enclosure work at the same cosmetic standard will also be considered.

**The thing that actually limits this floor**

We're high-mix. Many moulds, frequent changes, moderate volume per run. In that environment the constraint usually isn't cycle time — it's
**changeover and the scrap that follows it.**
Every tool change costs setup hours, then costs more shots before the process stabilises. Across a week of changes that's a serious share of capacity spent producing nothing.

Most moulding operations measure cycle time obsessively and changeover barely at all. We'd like someone who goes after it.

**What you'd build**

* **Changeover discipline**
  — SMED method, prepared tooling, parallel setup, and a measured changeover time that comes down
* Validated parameter sets per mould, so a setter isn't rediscovering the process each time, and a first-off routine that reaches stable quickly and records what stable looked like
* **Material handling discipline**
  — polymer dried to spec before it goes near a machine. Wet resin causes splay and cosmetic defects that get blamed on printing two stations later
* A skill matrix for setters and operators, with certification before anyone runs unsupervised, and cross-training so capacity doesn't depend on one person's attendance
* Real downtime and scrap data coded by cause, so improvement has something to aim at
* Capacity planning and the case for new machines as we grow

**You'd own**

* Moulding production across shifts, against the plan
* **Scrap and first-pass yield at the machine.**
  Your primary number
* Process capability, parameter control and changeover performance
* Machine utilisation, uptime and maintenance coordination
* **Tool condition in production**
  — shot counts, preventive maintenance schedules, spare inserts and components, and escalation to the tool room before a tool fails rather than after
* Tool repair and refurbishment decisions, with the cost case
* Moulding capacity decisions and capital proposals
* The moulding team — setters, operators, helpers, supervisors — including hiring and training
* Safety, 5S and housekeeping

**You need**

* 12+ years in
  **injection moulding**
  , with function or plant-level ownership rather than shift supervision alone
* **Mobile handset moulding experience — mandatory.**
  Housings, covers or cosmetic enclosures, at a handset OEM or in their tier-one supplier base. See the note above
* **Hands-on process capability.**
  You can set a machine, read a short shot, and tell a setter what to change and why
* Defect diagnosis: short shot, flash, sink, weld lines, warpage, splay, burn marks — cause, not just name
* **Material knowledge**
  — PC, ABS, PC/ABS, TPU, PP and filled grades; drying requirements, moisture sensitivity, masterbatch and regrind
  **Overmoulding.**
  A real part of our production and not a side skill:
* **Two-shot and insert moulding**
  — rotary platen, index and core-back methods, or mould-and-transfer. The machine and tool requirements of each, and when one suits better than the other
* **Material pairing and bond**
  — which combinations bond chemically, which need mechanical interlock, and how melt temperature, shore hardness and surface condition affect adhesion. TPU and TPE over PC and PC/ABS specifically
* **Bond strength as an invisible defect.**
  An overmoulded part can look perfect and delaminate weeks later in a customer's hand. It has to be designed and processed right, because inspection won't catch it. Peel and bond testing is part of the job, not an afterthought
* **Differential shrinkage and warpage**
  between the two materials, and first-shot dimensional stability before the second shot
* **Cycle balancing**
  — the slower shot sets the cycle, which makes process optimisation here a different problem from single-shot
* Interface flash, colour bleed and the cosmetic defects specific to two-material parts

**Tooling, in detail.**
This is not a nice-to-have for us:

* **Tool construction**
  — mould base and insert construction, steel grades and hardness, cold and hot runner systems, gate types and vestige, cooling layout and what it does to cycle and warpage, venting, ejection, slides and lifters, shut-off surfaces, surface finish and texture
* **Two-shot tool construction**
  — rotation and indexing, sealing at the material interface, second-shot shut-offs, and why these tools fail differently from single-shot ones
* **Tool condition on the floor**
  — reading flash as parting line wear, galling on slides, blocked vents causing burns, scaled water lines quietly adding seconds to cycle, ejector wear, hot runner tip and heater faults. Catching these before they become a stoppage or a scrap run
* **Trials and correction**
  — T0/T1/T2, reading trial results, steel-safe versus steel-removal corrections, shrinkage adjustment, and knowing when a correction is worth doing
* **Repair, refurbish or replace**
  , with the judgement and the cost case behind each
* **The arbitration.**
  The most valuable thing you'll do is decide whether a defect is a tool problem or a process problem. Process people blame the tool, tool rooms blame the process, and the part keeps failing while they argue. We want someone who settles it with evidence
* **Demonstrated changeover or scrap reduction with numbers.**
  We'll ask for before and after
* Team building across shifts, including developing setters
* Fluent Hindi; working English

**Good to have:**
tool room or tool design background earlier in your career, scientific moulding or DOE training, multi-cavity and high-cavitation tooling, IMD/IML, take-out robots and automation, SMED implementation, CIPET background, OEE systems.

**Where this sits alongside our Tooling Engineer:**
they own mould design review and new tool development; you own tools in production — condition, maintenance, correction and when to retire them. You'll disagree occasionally, and that's healthy.

**Tell us:**
which handset programmes or customers you moulded for, your overmoulding experience and the material pairs you've run, your average changeover time and what you did to it, your scrap rate and how it was measured,
**one defect where you proved it was the tool and not the process (or the reverse) and how you proved it**
, and the cosmetic standard you worked to.

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.

* **Ownership beyond launch.**
  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

How to apply

Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you.

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:

s and

, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

**Examples of Problems You'll Tackle**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

**Why Join**

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

**We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.**

**Apply Now!**

title: Principal Mobile Engineer
description: About PayoneerFounded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.Principal Mobile Engineer AI-Native Cloud PlatformTeam: Mobile Platform TeamReports to: Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud PlatformLocation: [Gurgaon / Hybrid]About The RolePayoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations — observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation — and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model.We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision — native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid — and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route.What You’ll OwnYou will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation — native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid — against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership.You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team’s first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship.You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against.You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days.You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform — APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it.What We’re Looking ForYou have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up — not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them.You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem.You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference — performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails — and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer’s scale.You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows.You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio.You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well — including with your peer Principal — and you know how to land a joint decision.Nice to haveExperience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications — on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them — is a strong plus, given Payoneer’s AI-native platform direction.Why this role mattersThe mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge.The Payoneer Ways of WorkingAct as our customer’s partner on the insideLearning what they need and creating what will help them go further.Do it. Own it.Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.Continuously improveAlways striving for a higher standard than our last.Build Each Other UpHelping each other grow, as professionals and people.If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Software Development Engineer -1
description:
**About Mechademy**

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**
  Design, build and own features on a secure, multi-tenant platform used by enterprise clients across the globe. Work on authentication, access control and auditability, web and mobile experiences, and APIs that let other systems work with platform data safely.
* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description: Who We AreInovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. You design and build full stack solutions that support data driven products and platform capabilities across modern cloud environments. In this role, you contribute to responsive user experiences, scalable backend services, and distributed systems that support the performance, reliability, and security of Inovalon’s data platform.What You'll Do Design, develop, deploy, test, and support technical solutions using full stack development tools and technologies. Build user friendly, responsive web interfaces using modern web application frameworks and front end technologies. Develop backend services and application logic using Java, SQL, and Python, and build front end functionality using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Design and implement solutions using relational and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on scalable data access and performance. Deploy microservices using container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with AWS managed services and related cloud tools. Troubleshoot complex distributed systems and resolve application and performance issues across the platform. Contribute to secure web application development by applying best practices in software design, implementation, and deployment. Support CI and CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques to improve software delivery and release reliability. Collaborate effectively with team members in a fast paced agile environment to deliver scalable platform solutions. Stay current with trends and technologies in backend and front end development and apply relevant improvements to engineering work.What You'll Need 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Java development, and 3+ years of experience with JavaScript using modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js. Bachelor of Technology, Master of Technology, Bachelor of Engineering, Master of Sciences, or Master of Computer Applications, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience required. Strong experience with Java, SQL, Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Expert level knowledge of RDBMS, SQL, and NoSQL database technologies. Demonstrated experience with caching, queuing, scheduling, concurrency, and event driven architectures. Demonstrated experience developing applications on or for Linux platforms. Proven track record implementing distributed systems, microservice architectures, and RESTful APIs. Strong experience with AWS preferred, and experience with Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or other cloud platforms. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques. Knowledge of best practices for implementing secure web applications. Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by staying current with emerging backend, front end, cloud, and platform technologies, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes. Demonstrate leadership by collaborating effectively with cross functional partners, contributing technical expertise in agile environments, and helping move complex platform work forward across the team. Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to evolving requirements, changing priorities, and the demands of fast paced platform development. Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical solutions to distributed systems challenges, performance issues, and full stack design problems. Demonstrate analytical skills by troubleshooting complex technical issues, evaluating system behavior, and using evidence to make sound engineering decisions. Nice to have: Experience in data pipelines; experience with big data technologies such as Snowflake and Datastax.Our Shared Commitments Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement; Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.Work Environment This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.To review the legal requirements, including all labor law posters, please visit this linkTo review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this linkWork Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

DeHaat is one of India’s fastest-growing agri-tech companies and one of very few that serve farmers end to end, from seeds to market. * Prior internship in product, analytics, or a startup
* Exposure to LLM APIs, no-code tools (n8n, Zapier, lovable, emergent)

**What you’ll get**

* Real ownership of a shipped feature used by lakhs of farmers
* Field exposure to rural India that few product roles offer

title: Flutter Developer
description:
Flutter Developer — Challenge App

💰 ₹15,000/month · 📍 Fully Remote (India) · 💼 Full-time

About us

We're an early-stage startup building Challenge App — a mobile platform that helps people run and join multi-day growth challenges. Users create challenges with structured action steps, track their progress day-by-day, see how their community is doing on leaderboards, and stay on track with reminders and accountability features.

We're a small team, and we build fast using AI-assisted development (Cursor + Claude). That means less time typing boilerplate, more time making smart architecture decisions and shipping real features. If you've been curious about working with AI tools or already love them — you'll fit right in.

Qualifications

• 1-3 years of hands-on experience with Flutter/Dart

• Published at least one Flutter app (Play Store, App Store, or equivalent)

• Strong understanding of clean architecture, SOLID principles, and design patterns

• Comfortable reading and reviewing code — not just writing it

• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote, async setup

• Good communication skills — you'll be collaborating directly with the founder

🔴 Must Have Skills

• Flutter / Dart — Our entire frontend. You need to be comfortable here.

• Clean Architecture — We follow strict layers: Page → Cubit → UseCase → Repository → API. Not negotiable.

• BLoC / Cubit (flutter\_bloc) — Every feature uses it for state management.

• Dio — All API integration goes through these.

• Freezed + build\_runner — Code generation for models and state classes.

• GetIt + Injectable — Dependency injection throughout the app.

• GoRouter — Navigation and deep linking.

• Firebase — Auth, Firestore, Storage, and Cloud Messaging.

• Functional error handling — Either<Failure, T> pattern with dartz/fpdart.

• AI-code review skills — You need to catch when AI gets it wrong — this is the real skill.

🟢 Good to Have

• Node.js / TypeScript — Our backend is Express + MongoDB + Zod, on Google Cloud.

• MongoDB / Mongoose — Schema design, indexing, queries.

• Shorebird — OTA code push for instant updates.

• Razorpay — Payment gateway we use.

• Hive CE — Local caching and storage.

• Media handling — Camera, image picker/cropper, video, audio recording.

• Charts (fl\_chart) — Data visualization in the app.

• Push + local notifications — firebase\_messaging + flutter\_local\_notifications.

• Google Cloud Platform — Where our backend runs.

How we work

• AI-first workflow — Cursor + Claude is our daily driver. You'll direct AI, review its output, and handle the parts it can't.

• Clean, enforced architecture — the codebase has rules, and we follow them.

• You'll have real ownership — small team means your decisions matter.

• Async-friendly & flexible hours — work when you're most productive.

title: Mobile Engineer III, iOS
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Mobile Engineer III, iOS**
**Introduction to the Team**
Expedia Technology teams partner our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. Our unified technology platform, powered by data and machine learning, enables secure, personalized, and differentiated experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
  
  
The Expedia Group Cars team owns the end-to-end car rental shopping and booking. We build scalable, high-performance systems that enable travelers to plan, search, compare, and book rental cars seamlessly across web and native app platforms.
  
  
We are looking for native iOS engineers who are excited to contribute to the growth and evolution of the Cars business by delivering impactful features and services that delight customers and partners. You will work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where ownership, technical excellence, and innovation are highly valued.
  
  
Team members in Cars are accountable for delivery and outcomes in a high-impact environment. We embody the “One Team” philosophy and apply Agile, Lean, Continuous Delivery, and data-driven principles across engineering and operations.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, develop, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and related Apple frameworks, ensuring performant, reliable, and maintainable mobile experiences.
* Contribute to system design, including API contracts, low-level design, and data modeling for mobile features that integrate with backend services and shared platforms.
* Implement high-quality, testable code by applying engineering best practices in code structure, unit testing, integration testing, and code reviews within an agile development environment.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple product areas or domains to deliver reusable mobile components and services that can be leveraged across Expedia Group brands.
* Diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in production and pre-production environments, contributing to robust monitoring, logging, and operational excellence for iOS applications.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled or AI‑assisted solutions within mobile workflows, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in software development.
* Professional experience (typically 2–5 years) building and shipping native iOS applications using Swift, Xcode, and core iOS frameworks.
* Hands-on experience owning features or services end-to-end within a mobile application, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Solid understanding of mobile system design fundamentals, including API design, data modeling, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization on iOS.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a collaborative engineering environment, participating in code reviews, using source control, and following established engineering and operational practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving iOS application architectures (such as MVVM, VIPER, or similar patterns) and contributing to shared mobile platforms or libraries used across multiple teams or product areas.
* Background working with large-scale consumer mobile applications, including performance tuning, offline capabilities, analytics integration, and experimentation to drive data-informed improvements.
* Proven contribution to system and API design in partnership with backend and platform teams, including defining contracts, data schemas, and integration patterns for mobile clients.
* Experience safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions on mobile (for example, AI-assisted search, recommendations, personalization, or content generation), with familiarity using AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows in product development.

title: Engineering Manager (Mobile)
description:
**Who We Are:**

Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centres, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 500 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.

HIGHLIGHTS:

* Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
* Fareportal partners with over 500 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
* 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
* Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.
* Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a high-performing Engineering Manager (Mobile) with comprehensive, end-to-end requirement-to-delivery experience. In this role, you will transition from individual contribution to managing a high-caliber team of mobile engineers, including Team Leads and Staff Engineers.

You will own the technical architecture, cross-platform development, native modules, UI styling frameworks, and API integrations for our iOS and Android applications. As a delivery and people leader, you will be entirely responsible for the "Concept-to-Store" lifecycle, ensuring our mobile booking engines scale to handle peak OTA traffic with maximum uptime.

**Core Responsibilities:**

**Delivery, Architecture & Technical Strategy**

**End-to-End Requirement to Delivery Ownership**
: Take total accountability for the mobile roadmap from initial product requirement scoping to final store deployment. Ensure predictable sprint velocities and on-time delivery across multiple parallel tracks.

**Architectural Governance**
: Oversee and approve client-side mobile architectures. Guide the team on when to leverage cross-platform modules (React Native) versus writing native performance bridges (Swift/Kotlin).

**API & Data Orchestration Strategy**
: Enforce robust security and performance standards for data layers interacting with RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Client), and real-time WebSockets. Ensure seamless optimization for low-bandwidth environments.

**MarTech Ecosystem & Routing**
: Oversee the integration and performance impact of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like AppsFlyer/Branch), customer engagement platforms (e.g., CleverTap, Braze), and ensure flawless execution of complex deep linking/universal links across the booking funnel.

**Release Train, CI/CD & OTA Updates**
: Orchestrate continuous delivery and automated release tracks using Fastlane and GitHub Actions. Manage Over-The-Air (OTA) update strategies (e.g., CodePush or EAS Update) to rapidly deploy JavaScript bundles and hotfix critical production bugs without waiting for Apple/Google store review cycles.

**App Store Ecosystem & Policy Governance**
: Act as the final gatekeeper for App Store Connect and Google Play Console. Navigate complex store review guidelines, manage rejection appeals, and ensure the app stays compliant with evolving platform policies.

**Scalability & Traffic Spikes**
: Design robust, high-concurrency client architectures capable of handling sudden, massive traffic surges typical of B2C flash sales, holiday booking rushes, and flash marketing events without degradation.

**Leading Elite Mobile Teams & Culture**

**Managing High-Performer**
**Dynamics**
: Successfully lead, inspire, and retain an elite team of highly skilled developers. Turn divergent technical opinions among senior engineers into unified architectural decisions.

**Product & Stakeholder Partnership**
: Act as the strategic counterpart to Product Managers and UX/UI Leads. Translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, negotiate sprint scopes, and ensure engineering deliverables align tightly with OTA business KPIs (conversion rates, booking funnel optimization).

**Engineering Craftsmanship**
: Promote a high-standard engineering culture focused on code quality, thorough documentation, reusable UI component libraries, and automated testing (Jest, Detox, Appium).

**Technical Debt & ROI Management**
: Strategically balance feature delivery with technical debt. Advocate for engineering refactors by translating technical gains (e.g., modularization) into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.

**Talent Cultivation & Growth**
: Run quarterly performance reviews, establish clear individual career ladders, and mentor team leads. Design rigorous interview loops to attract top-tier mobile talent in a competitive market.

**Advanced Competency Standards**

**Security, Compliance & Data Protection**

**PII & Payment Data Security**
: Demonstrate a strong understanding of best practices for securing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Payment Card Industry (PCI) data within mobile clients, guiding the team on safe payment processing and data tokenization without acting as the primary compliance officer.

**Data Localization & Privacy**
: Architect storage and transmission strategies that respect regional data localization laws and data-at-rest encryption requirements.

**WebView & Boundary Hardening**
: Mitigate advanced WebView vulnerabilities—including Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and script injection—ensuring strict security controls over hybrid features.

**Network**
&
**Authentication Security**
: Mandate certificate pinning across native and cross-platform network layers. Manage complex token lifecycles and secure token exchanges (OAuth, JWT) seamlessly across native/web boundaries.

**Reliability, Observability & Performance**

**React Native Performance Tuning**
: Optimize React Native-specific bottlenecks, including JS thread blocking, memory leaks, bridge traffic reduction, and Hermes engine tuning to ensure native-like 60fps scrolling and fast TTI (Time to Interactive).

**Telemetry Infrastructure**
: Establish expert-level implementation of Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and logging tools (e.g., Sentry, Datadog, New Relic).

**Actionable Insights**
: Transform raw error metrics, crash logs, and latency telemetry into clear, prioritized technical backlogs that actively improve app stability and user retention.

**Production Guardrails**
: Define, monitor, and defend strict operational SLAs, targeting a >99.9% crashfree user rate and optimized app launch velocities.

**Global Accessibility (a11y)**
: Ensure the application meets WCAG guidelines and supports native screen readers (VoiceOver/TalkBack), maintaining an inclusive booking experience for all users. Required

**Technical Skills & Stack**

**UI & Core Frameworks:**
React Native, Redux/React Query/MobX, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind CSS, and React Native StyleSheet.

**Native Development Platforms**
: iOS (Xcode, Swift, Objective-C, UIKit/SwiftUI, Core Data) and Android (Android Studio, Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, SQLite/Room).

**API Integration & Networking**
: RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Client), WebSockets, Axios, and RTK Query.

**Infrastructure, OTA & MarTech**
: CodePush / Expo Application Services (EAS), AppsFlyer, Branch, Firebase, or similar MMP/Engagement SDKs.

**Testing & Automation**
: Jest, Detox, Appium, XCTest, Espresso, Fastlane, and mobile CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

**Qualifications**

**Experience:**
10+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 3 years specifically in Engineering Management directly leading mobile teams.

**Proven Scale**
: Proven experience managing large scale D2C app development in a B2C organization.
**Domain Expertise**
: Experience in the travel domain would be helpful but is not mandatory.

**Education**
: Engineering degree from a Tier 1 college.

**Disclaimer**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company’s sole discretion, with or without notice.

title: Senior iOS Developer - Swift, Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
description:
**Location:**
100% Remote
  
  
**Employment:**
Full-time, long-term position
  
  
**Start date:**
As soon as possible after selection and agreement
  
  
**Salary:**
Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility
  
  
**About Us**
We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.
  
  
We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.
  
  
Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.
  
  
You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
* Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
* Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
* Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
* Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
* Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
* Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
* Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
* Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
* Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
* Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
* Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
* Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
* Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
* A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
* The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
* Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
* The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
* BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
* UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
* NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
* Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
* Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
* Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
* The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
* Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

**Remote Working Arrangement**
Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.
  
  
Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.
  
  
Include:
  
  

* Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
* Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
* Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
* The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
* Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.
